d:
Pipal agenst SIR ke bainar tale 23 aktubar ko desh ke alag-alag hisson men pradarshan kie gae. dilli men SIR ke khilaf aur mukhy chunav aayukt gyanesh kumar ke istife ki mang ko lekar chhatr, kisan, mazdur aur ektivist dophar qarib ek baje bangla sahib gurudvare ke pas jute.
Pradarshan men AISA, AISF, SFI aur KYS samet kaee vampanthi chhatr sangthan shamil hue. iske alava kisan aur mahila sangathnon ke sadasyon ne bhi hissa liya.
